The '''E-16/x ion engine''' was a model of [[Ion engine/Legends|ion engine]] used by [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation]] in the manufacture of some of their products, such as the [[T-16 skyhopper/Legends|T-16 skyhopper]]. With the E-16/x, skyhoppers were able to fly at speeds of up to 1,200 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] per [[Standard hour/Legends|hour]].<ref name="EGVV" />
